description.value:
There is another one underneath, and it is ready before you are.

Gift — Once per day, as a reaction to being grabbed, restrained or bound: shed and escape automatically, leaving the skin behind. Tithe — The new skin takes a day to set. You're clumsy 1 and take −2 circumstance to anything relying on touch or temperature for 24 hours — and the skin you left is a perfect sample of you for whoever picks it up.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability is a once-per-day reaction that sheds skin to auto-escape a grab/restrain/bind, with a following 24-hour clumsy/touch penalty as its direct consequence -- granting a new limited-use reaction is the same class of gap as Loyal-Blood, out of scope for a rule-element-only pass.
